Generational Indian Goldsmith Heritage

The Pillars of Our Atelier

Every creation at Alankar Luxury is born from centuries-old hereditary techniques that machines cannot replicate.

Artisan Origin: Jaipur & Bikaner, Rajasthan
Ancestral Setting of Uncut Natural Stones

24K Pure Gold Jadau Foiling

The ancient art of Jadau involves encasing uncut natural Polki stones within pure 24K gold foil without any synthetic adhesives. Every stone is cradled by hand-pressed pure gold leaf, reflecting light with soft courtly luminescence.

100% Pure 24K bullion gold foil inlay
Natural untreated stones with organic inclusions
Artisanal Meenakari enamel on the gold reverse
100% Certified Purity Guaranteed by Alankar Luxury

Generational Goldsmiths
The Alankar Heritage

Where Royal Indian Goldsmith Tradition Meets Complete Bridal Splendour.

At ALANKAR LUXURY, jewellery is a sacred heirloom of emotional devotion, royal genealogy, and ancestral artistry. Established with an unwavering reverence for the classical Indian goldsmithing traditions, our boutique stores showcase masterpieces crafted in pure 22K hallmarked gold and pure 92.5 sterling silver.

Our collections celebrate the complete journey of Indian womanhood—from grand royal Polki Jadau chokers and sacred temple Nakashi harams, to forehead Mathapattis, sculpted gold Kamarbandh waist belts, pure silver pooja heirlooms, and bespoke handcrafted Zardozi bridal potlis.

We maintain an uncompromising standard of purity: 100% government BIS 916 laser hallmarking, BIS 925 sterling silver certification, and handpicked untreated gemstones. In our welcoming stores, patrons experience jewellery consultation as it was meant to be—warm, unhurried, and deeply memorable.
